title: Wake/Sleep Presence Control
required_previous_checkpoint: accepted 0.1.0 Desktop App Alpha through Repair4 source tree
scope: Local sleeping wake lane, embedded wake-command preservation, explicit and inactivity sleep lifecycle, typed wake, and sleep/wake desktop presence while Realtime Mini + Cedar + WebRTC remains the replaceable awake conversational frontend.
live_acceptance: pending local wake, same-utterance command, explicit sleep, auto-sleep, typed wake, minimized wake, and shutdown confirmation

wake_sleep.sleeping_audio_boundary: renderer microphone -> loopback Core only; no Realtime call until wake confirmation
wake_sleep.local_wake_stack: Silero via whisper.cpp VAD + whisper.cpp endpointed final STT + WakePhraseDetector
wake_sleep.opening_command: wake phrase stripped locally; remaining complete utterance enters newly opened Realtime session as input_text
wake_sleep.explicit_sleep: Realtime lifecycle-only sleep_jarvis signal -> renderer closes Realtime -> local wake re-arms
wake_sleep.typed_wake: typed input while sleeping opens same Realtime conversation path
wake_sleep.production_caveat: full Whisper is accepted for alpha but a lighter dedicated keyword spotter should be benchmarked for low-end/mobile hardware

authority_invariants: sleeping/awake presence remains separate from foreground activity state
sleeping microphone audio never enters OpenAI Realtime before local wake confirmation
wake/sleep lifecycle does not gain memory, tool, task, permission, or backend model authority
delegate_to_jarvis_core remains the only Realtime function that can request authoritative backend work; sleep_jarvis is lifecycle-only
Electron/React remains a thin client; Jarvis Core remains authoritative
Realtime Mini/Cedar/WebRTC and local wake providers remain replaceable
known_limitations: wake word is not yet user-editable in the UI
desktop alpha uses local whisper.cpp full transcription rather than a dedicated low-power keyword spotter
renderer background throttling is disabled to preserve minimized wake reliability; a lower-power native/audio worker should be evaluated later
mobile/background OS wake integration is deferred
durable chat history and cross-session memory UI are deferred
